title: iAkauntan — promotional film
voice: Plain, declarative, unhyped. Every claim on screen is a fact stated in README.md and asserted in supabase/tests/.

items: A missed date is a penalty.
An unbalanced ledger is a rebuild.
A wrong rate is on every payslip.

shot.prompt: Extreme slow push-in across a dark office desk at night, a single warm desk lamp raking light over a stack of unopened statutory envelopes and a wall calendar with one date circled in red. Deep shadow, teal-black ambience, shallow depth of field, anamorphic flare, 35mm film grain. No text, no people, no readable documents. Locked cinematic mood, no camera shake.

layout.text: Accounting · CRM · HR & Payroll · Corporate Secretarial · LHDN e-Invoice
Built for Malaysian business. Flutter on the front, Postgres underneath.

shot.prompt: Abstract deep-teal liquid ink blooming outward from centre against near-black, resolving into a calm horizontal plane of light. Slow, elegant, premium fintech title backdrop. Volumetric depth, subtle particulate, no text, no logos, no people. 24fps cinematic motion.

layout.text: A deferred constraint trigger refuses to commit an unbalanced journal. Weighted-average costing, SST and Bank Negara 5-sen rounding are asserted in CI, not eyeballed.

shot.prompt: Two columns of soft light on a black field, perfectly mirrored, gently settling until they align to exactly equal height, then a thin emerald rule snaps across joining them. Minimal, geometric, weightless. No text, no numbers, no UI. Dark teal-black, high contrast, cinematic.

layout.text:
e-Invoice is part of the invoice,
not a bolt-on.
UBL 2.1 · XAdES signing for version 1.1 · cancellation refused once the 72-hour window closes · every call kept for the 7-year trail.

shot.prompt: A single sheet of paper dissolving into a lattice of glowing teal data nodes that travel along clean orthogonal paths into the distance and are received by a soft pulse of green light. Clinical, elegant, dark background. No text, no logos, no people. Slow dolly, cinematic depth of field.

layout.text: It says why in words, never a percentage — a percentage reads as a machine being certain about something it cannot be certain about.

shot.prompt: Overhead macro shot of a crumpled paper receipt on a dark slate surface, a sheet of soft teal scanning light sweeping across it once, left to right, lifting faint luminous glyph-shapes off the page that float and settle into a neat grid. No legible text, no hands, no faces. Moody, shallow focus, cinematic film grain.

layout.text: Every schedule carries an effective range, so re-running March uses March’s rules. A gazetted change is an insert, not a deploy — and every payslip records which schedule produced it.

shot.prompt: Rows of thin horizontal light bars sliding into precise alignment like a settling ledger, each one illuminating in sequence with a soft emerald pulse, against deep black. Ordered, calm, mechanical precision. No text, no numbers, no people. Slow lateral camera drift, cinematic.

layout.text: None of them are typed in. Each is computed from the company’s own dates against the section that imposes it.

shot.prompt: An elegant dark clock face with no numerals, its hands replaced by slender beams of teal light that sweep and lock into four precise positions, each lock accompanied by a soft ring of emerald. Deep black background, volumetric haze, no text, no people. Slow cinematic push-in.

items.label: functions a tenant’s token can reach

layout.text: The API description is generated from the catalog and checked against the schema in CI. The SQL assertions run on every push — anything touching EPF, SOCSO, EIS, PCB or an SSM deadline has a test that fails if the number moves.

shot.prompt: A vast dark grid of tiny dim cells igniting row by row in emerald green, sweeping outward until the whole field is lit and steady. Data-centre scale, weightless, abstract. No text, no numbers, no people. Slow pull-back reveal, cinematic contrast.

layout.text: Double-entry books · SST · Inventory · Payroll · e-Invoice
Built for Malaysia. Verified end to end.

shot.prompt: Deep-teal ink settling to perfect stillness on a black field, a single horizontal emerald rule holding steady at centre, faint particulate drifting upward. Calm, resolved, premium. No text, no logos, no people. Locked-off cinematic shot.
